scientific_question: Can an independently calibrated semantic-choice channel provide a robust monotone ruler on fresh prompt families?

factorial_code_design.purpose: Separate semantic contrast, position bias, response-token bias, and their interaction.

mandatory_controls.code_mapping: Every literal code-key row must have positive raw target-oriented log odds in all presentation/code cells.
mandatory_controls.semantic_equality: The maximum absolute factorial-averaged target-oriented log odds for semantically identical descriptions contributes to the independent instrument radius.
mandatory_controls.probability_order: Every higher-probability copy of the same anchor lottery must dominate its lower-probability copy outside the instrument radius.
mandatory_controls.anchor_dominance: BEST must dominate every registered cell and every registered cell must dominate WORST outside the instrument radius.
mandatory_controls.cold_start_replay: Every prompt row is repeated after a process restart; the maximum target-log-odds replay delta contributes to the instrument radius.

monotone_ruler_gate.formula_ascii: d_inf(y,C) = 0.5 * max_{i<j} max(y_j-y_i,0), where C is the cone of nonincreasing curves
monotone_ruler_gate.curve_admission: For every required curve, d_inf is no larger than the derived radius, y(p=0) is at least the radius, and y(p=1) is at most minus the radius.

fixed_sequence_gates.condition: All probability-order and anchor-dominance controls pass outside the derived instrument radius.
All 36 standard and 18 compound ruler curves satisfy the monotone-distance and robust-endpoint conditions.
Every registered component/mixture tuple is jointly admitted by M0.

total_mapping.sequence_rule: Only pass opens the next gate; fail or not_evaluated stops the sequence.

execution_requirements.manifest: A compare-or-fail manifest derived deterministically from pilot_design_v035.py and marked registered_not_run.
execution_requirements.registration: A compare-or-fail environment registration binding the model, server, CUDA library, runner, analyzer, hard-cap wrapper, source artifacts, resource limits, commit, and manifest hashes.
execution_requirements.authorization: The live runner rejects draft or execution_authorized=false manifests.
execution_requirements.output: One write-once hashed receipt per query and a hash-bound aggregate analysis.

claim_boundary: This pilot can validate or reject one semantic-choice measurement channel. It cannot confirm mixture affinity, validate the v0.33 decision quotient on held-out behavior, authorize edits, establish a general value representation, or resolve ASMP-9.
